description:
Complete the post-cutover canonical JoinOrder UAT that was intentionally not
covered by the prior smoke-only cutover. The public `joinorder` benchmark now
points at canonical IMDb 2013 (`joinorder-imdb-2013-v1`) and exposes 113 SQL
queries at scale 1 only, but `results-data/bundles/` currently has no
canonical `joinorder` result bundles.

This item defines the canonical SF=1 support matrix, runs full local UAT on
included SQL platforms, validates every clean bundle, stages only complete
canonical results into `results-data/bundles/`, regenerates the corpus
inventory, and confirms the old invalid `joinorder_sf1_*` synthetic bundles
are absent.

anti_patterns.dont: copy a staged bundle into `results-data/bundles/` before validating its manifest sidecar hash.
include DataFrame platform bundles with only 13 translated queries.
include DataFusion SQL until `joinorder-datafusion-dialect` is resolved.

preserves.behavior: Do not change canonical JoinOrder runtime/query semantics in this corpus backfill.
Do not publish partial JoinOrder runs: included platforms require 113/113 query coverage.
Do not restore old `joinorder_sf1_*` synthetic bundle names.
Keep raw UAT logs under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`, not in git.

verifications.command: for f in _project/TODO/main/active/joinorder-canonical-corpus-uat-backfill.yaml _project/TODO/main/planning/joinorder-spark-dialect.yaml _project/TODO/main/planning/joinorder-sqlite-performance.yaml _project/TODO/main/planning/joinorder-presto-ddl.yaml; do uv run --project _project/scripts -- python _project/scripts/todo_cli.py validate "$f" || exit 1; done

uv run -- python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
for path in sorted(Path('results-data/bundles').glob('joinorder_sf1_*.json')):
    if path.name.endswith(('.manifest.json', '.plans.json', '.tuning.json')):
        continue
    data = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert data['benchmark']['id'] == 'joinorder'
    assert data['benchmark']['dataset_version'] == 'joinorder-imdb-2013-v1'
    print(path.name)
PY
verifications.description: No old invalid synthetic bundles remain under canonical joinorder name
Canonical JoinOrder staged bundles have full 113-query coverage and dataset identity fields

verifications.expected: joinorder SF=1.0: 3 platforms [OK]; command still exits nonzero on unrelated pre-existing shallow cohorts
